reason: The laws fix the set of processes in the critical section after each event sequence. An acquire must be refused when a live holder exists (Law 1 and Law 3) and granted when none exists (Law 2). A release by the holder must clear it (Law 4), and a release by any other process cannot change the holder (Law 3). The OS part of the state does not depend on the design, so each design that passes gives the same cs by induction on the trace.
